Version 0.1.2 · an early release for Windows and Linux

Free web AI chats, turned into a coding agent.

Ask for a change and it reads your project, edits files, runs commands and checks its work, asking before anything it should. The model is a chat site driven in a real browser: no API key, no per-token bill.

Download CloseNI Read the docs

From the site's side, it is a person typing. From yours, it is a coding agent working in your project folder.

  1. Open

    A Chromium window with your own session. You sign in once, in the real site.

  2. Ask

    Your request goes into the chat box, with the project's context and the tool conventions the model needs.

  3. Read

    It waits for the stream to end, parses the reply into tool calls, and runs the ones you allow.

  4. Check

    Tests, type checks and the build run on the result. A failure goes back to the model as the next prompt.

What it does

A chat site has no tool-calling API, so the tools are a convention written into the conversation. CloseNI teaches the model that convention and runs what comes back.

No API key
It opens a real Chromium window with the session you are signed into, types the prompt, waits for the reply to finish streaming and reads it back.
A coding agent
Reads and searches the project, edits files, runs commands and checks its work. File changes and commands ask first, as diffs you can read.
Plan, build, repair
For a larger job it plans, you revise the plan, and each step is built, checked and repaired before the next one starts.
Twelve languages
It picks the checks that fit the project: tests, type checks, a build, whichever the project actually has.
Safe by default
Writes stay inside the workspace, secret files are never read without asking, and every command can be refused.
Eleven themes
Terminal, Paper, Cassette, Phosphor and seven more, in a native Qt app with no web view anywhere.

Around the app

!

Read this before you sign in

  1. Use a throwaway account. Sign in with a dummy email made for CloseNI, never your main account.
  2. Your account can be banned. Automated use can break a provider's terms. The more prompts you send, the more likely the account is flagged or banned.
  3. It breaks when the site changes. CloseNI drives the chat site's own page, so a redesign can stop it working until the selectors are updated.
  4. Not recommended for production. It is an early release. Keep it away from production systems and code you cannot afford to lose.

You are using a site under its own terms. Check them before you sign in. Details.

Get CloseNI.

Version 0.1.2. A native Qt app with Node and the agent bundled. Chromium is downloaded on first run.

WindowsYour systemAn installer (.exe); you choose the folder. Windows 10 or later.↓ LinuxYour systemAn AppImage that runs anywhere, or a .deb for Debian and Ubuntu.↓

From source

Node 22.12+, Qt 6.8+, CMake 3.21+ and Ninja.

$ git clone https://github.com/siddarth1872004/CloseNI.git && cd CloseNI
$ npm install && npm run build
$ npx playwright install chromium
$ cmake -S native -B build-native -G Ninja
$ cmake --build build-native && npm start

The installers are unsigned. Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. The first run asks you to install Chromium and sign in to a provider once, with a throwaway account.
